name: Rudo Mangod, Holder of Light

shapes: continuous aura: while not(cardDepleted source) ('while restored') -> +1 strength / +1 life to each character you control
triggered:turnStarted (each turn, any player's) + source has a 'gear'-subtype card attached -> restore source

proposedCapabilities.spec: Extend the existing `hasAttachment` condition with an optional `ofSubtype?: string` filter, parallel to the current `ofType?: CardType`. True when at least one in-play card attached to `target` (default `__candidate` / `source`) has `ofSubtype` in its printed `CardDefinition.subtype` array. Same evaluation path as `ofType`, matching the subtype list instead of the card type; `ofType` and `ofSubtype` may combine (both must hold). No other shape change.
proposedCapabilities.why: Rudo Mangod, Holder of Light ('At the start of each turn, if this card has a 'gear' card attached to it, restore this card'). The same 'gear card attached' predicate recurs on 4p7 31f and its reprint ('While a gear card is attached to this card, it gains 1 strength and 1 life'). `hasAttachment` today only filters by CardType, and 'gear' is a subtype, not a type.

notes: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -> metadata.unique 'rudolphus'. 'While this card is restored' = not(cardDepleted source) gate on the aura. 2nd clause needs a subtype-aware attachment check (proposed has-attachment-subtype).

name: Uhluhtc Niudla

shapes: activated PREVAIL UPON: costs [moveSelected a resource you control -> its owner's hand; pick a player; payResources 1] -> chooserSelectsTarget (picked player) a face-down resource they control -> moveCard to its owner's hand

activated AVAIL ANEW: costs [moveSelected a resource from your hand -> shuffle into your deck (reveal); payResources 1] -> if cardNameEquals(cost-selected card, 'Obsession') grantKeyword covert untilEndOfTurn on source; draw 1

proposedCapabilities.spec: New `Cost` member `{ type:'moveSelected'; id:string; player:PlayerRef; selector:CardSelector; count:number; to:Zone; position?:'top'|'bottom'; shuffle?:boolean }`. Paid exactly like the `discard` cost: the activating player chooses `count` cards matching `selector` up front, supplied via `selected[id]`, legality-checked (zone/controller, no duplicates, exactly `count`) before the ability can be paid for; on payment they move to `to` (`position` for a deck; `shuffle` reshuffles that deck per CR §313.2). All-or-nothing like every other cost. 'Reveal' in printed text is cosmetic (no hidden-info model). Referable afterwards via `{selected id}` for a follow-up condition.
proposedCapabilities.why: Uhluhtc Niudla — PREVAIL UPON ('COST: Put a resource you control into its owner's hand.') and AVAIL ANEW ('COST: Reveal a resource from your hand and shuffle it into your deck.'). No existing Cost moves a chosen card to hand or shuffles it into a deck: `discard` only targets the discard pile; `sacrificeSelected` dispositions are removeFromGame|destroy|discard.

notes: UNIQUE UHLUHTC -> metadata.unique 'uhluhtc'. Effect sides compose from existing vocab (chooserSelectsTarget face-down resource -> moveCard to hand; cardNameEquals on the cost-selected card for the Obsession branch; draw is unconditional). Only the two costs need the new primitive. 'Pick a player' degenerates to the one opponent — no parity gap. Also the fetch target of Seriously Weird Crystalline Artefact's SERAPHIM FUSION.
